thread:
julia: FYI PR #4890 is a docs-cleanup for SOC2 evidence/retention examples. I found three small issues: a Ruby snippet still points to the old gem path, the CLI csv example posts to /v1/evidence, and an internal anchor to #evidence-retention-old 404s in the new layout. Can someone pick these up?

omar: tagging in. which files exactly?

julia: docs/compliance/evidence.md, docs/sdk/ruby/export_snippets.md, and docs/examples/cli/export_csv.md.

tess: i'll take the Ruby and CLI. quick question: are we allowed to alter the sample actor values? legal prefers placeholders instead of real org names.

julia: yes replace with placeholders (org-abc) per the style guide, but do not change any retention wording or TTL numbers.

legal-bot: Legal quick check: only mechanical example changes allowed. Retention and redaction language must be unchanged. Add exact PR note: "docs-only: examples modernized; no policy or TTL changes."

omar: noted. tess, for the Ruby snippet use the new gem name `redwood_inference` and keep the sample response object identical.

tess: proposed Ruby snippet (will push to the branch):

```ruby
# SDK v2 (Ruby)
require 'redwood_inference'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.audit.log(event: 'export_initiated', actor: 'org-abc')
```

tess: CLI csv fix: replace `/v1/evidence` with `/v2/evidence` and use placeholder actor.

julia: also please add a small docs redirect in the nav yaml: `/docs/compliance/evidence#evidence-retention-old` -> `/docs/compliance/evidence#evidence-retention` so old anchors don't break external links.

omar: i'll add the redirect entry. I'll also update the changelog line in the PR description to exactly what legal requested and tag `#no-policy-change`.

ci-bot: Preview deployed https://deploy.preview.redwood/doc/5543219999 PR #4890 :white_check_mark:

julia: thanks everyone. i'll QA the preview after the commits land and merge if no regressions. :thumbsup:
